description: Implement a specialized Triton GEQRF path for n=512, batch=640 using blocked Householder panels plus fused trailing-matrix updates, with exact torch.geqrf compact H,tau semantics and fallback for all other shapes; minimize Python/LAPACK launches and target the 512-dominant benchmark cases.

Build a Triton large-shape-only QR path for n=1024,2048,4096 using blocked TSQR or panel factorization with Householder-compatible H,tau output matching torch.geqrf; keep small and n=512 on torch.geqrf and prioritize reduced cubic constant for single/few-matrix cases.

Implement Triton structural fast paths for special benchmark cases such as upper, rank-deficient, clustered, near-rank, and mixed batches by detecting cheap per-matrix structure on GPU and emitting valid compact Householder factors, falling back to torch.geqrf for dense hard cases.

Implement high-confidence Triton structural fast paths only for cheaply provable cases such as exact upper-triangular, diagonal, or zero-column matrices detected by GPU reductions; emit LAPACK-compatible compact Householder output with tau=0 where valid and fall back to torch.geqrf for anything not exactly certified.

Implement true compact Householder QR semantics in Triton for n=32 and n=176 first, using one matrix per program or a small panel pipeline to produce H/R-packed output and tau matching torch.geqrf within tolerance; route n>=352 to torch.geqrf until correctness and speedup are validated, avoiding wrapper-only copies.

Implement a Triton Cholesky-QR macro for dense numerically well-conditioned cases: compute G=A^T A, factor R, and only form outputs if they satisfy the actual compact Householder H,tau contract; use numeric conditioning/rank/residual guards and fall back to torch.geqrf for ill-conditioned, rank-deficient, mixed, or contract-incompatible inputs.

Off the e822fc30 global-best tail-zero fast path, micro-optimize the existing n=512/1024 certified whole-batch case by fusing zero-fill and H,tau embedding into Triton scatter kernels while preserving exact current semantics; only after a measured win, try minimal stable batch-index compaction/scatter for mixed batches without changing the QR math or certification predicate.

Off e822fc30, explore an approximate tail-screened QR path for n=512 only: use Triton per-column norm scans to identify suffix columns conservatively negligible relative to ||A||F with a fixed FP32-epsilon threshold, factor only the leading panel and zero-embed H,tau, falling back to exact-zero or torch.geqrf unless independent stricter residual and orthogonality checks pass.

From e822fc30, add exact per-matrix tail-zero routing for mixed n=512/1024 batches: use Triton certification to produce a boolean mask, keep the existing whole-batch fast path when all matrices certify, otherwise compact certified matrices into leading-panel geqrf subbatches, zero-embed and scatter H,tau by original indices, and route uncertified or stride-ambiguous cases through full geqrf.

Combine 47d4 exact per-matrix tail-zero routing with 72ff fused stride-aware Triton H/tau scatter: use 47d4 as the base, preserve its certification mask, compaction, fallback, and output ordering exactly, and only replace certified-subbatch zero/H/tau embedding with 72ff validated fused scatter kernels guarded by the same eligibility mask.

Micro-specialize 47d4 exact tail-zero routing: profile overhead, split n=512 and n=1024 fast paths with a cheap whole-batch tail predicate that bypasses per-matrix compaction only when globally conclusive, otherwise fall back exactly to 47d4 routing; tune Triton certification block sizes per n and measurement-gate any n=1024 routing bypass on active mixed/nearrank correctness and metric.

Starting from 47d4, reduce host sync and indexing overhead in exact per-matrix tail-zero routing for mixed n=512/1024 while keeping 47d4 certification and fallback decisions bit-for-bit identical; measure sync/index cost, then try GPU-resident fixed-mask scatter or prefix compaction only if it removes certified.sum().item()/nonzero CPU roundtrips without changing order or fallback coverage.

Combine f414 tuned n=512 Triton tail-certification scan block=4096 with only 9925 validated n=512 fused H/tau embedding: preserve f414 dispatch, certification, fallback, and non-n=512 behavior exactly, gate fused embedding strictly to n=512 after existing certification conditions, and benchmark whether scan and embedding gains stack.
